# Flow State

> Flow State is a marketing agency run by brothers Salvino and Sherwin Madison. We help local businesses (salons, spas, med spas, clinics, cafés, boutique hotels, fitness studios) get more bookings through Meta Ads, Google Ads, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization: getting recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude).

## Services
- Meta Ads: Instagram and Facebook campaigns, creative testing, retargeting.
- Google Ads: Search and Performance Max campaigns, conversion tracking.
- GEO: schema and entity markup, citation building, AI visibility monitoring.
